title: Financing Basis of Charges Disputed in a Separation Response, by Tax Account Class
content:
How an employer pays for benefits decides the money a separation response under Employer Benefit Charging can dispute. The employer's financing is read from its Employer Unemployment Insurance Tax Accounts record.

## Rule

The financing basis of the counted charges is, where the employer's tax account finances benefits by contributions and holds a reserve account credited with its contributions, the counted charges themselves, every one of which reaches that reserve account; where the tax account finances benefits by reimbursement and has been billed for the quarter of the most recently mailed statement, the amount billed for that quarter; and nothing otherwise, a reimbursing employer not yet billed having paid nothing a response could dispute.

## Reading the tax account

- **Financing by contributions**: the tax account's financing class begins "Contributory —" (New Employer Standard Rate, New Employer Construction Rate, Experience-Rated Positive Reserve, Experience-Rated Deficit Reserve, Delinquent Reporting Assigned Rate).
- **A reserve account credited with its contributions**: the tax account shows at least one entry crediting contributions paid to the employer's reserve account, in any quarter.
- **Financing by reimbursement**: the financing class begins "Reimbursing —" (Nonprofit Organization, Governmental Entity).
- **Billed for the quarter of the most recently mailed statement**: the tax account shows a reimbursement bill for the quarter covered by the statement of benefit charges most recently mailed for the position; the amount billed is the total of the bills for that quarter.

## Branches

| Tax account | Reserve credit or bill for the statement quarter | Financing basis |
|---|---|---|
| Contributory | Reserve credited with contributions | The counted charges themselves |
| Contributory | No reserve credit on record | Nothing |
| Reimbursing | Billed for the quarter (an amount above zero) | The amount billed for that quarter |
| Reimbursing | Not billed for that quarter | Nothing |

## Illustrations (hypothetical)

- A Contributory — Experience-Rated Deficit Reserve employer whose reserve has been credited with contributions, with counted charges of $640.00: financing basis $640.00.
- A Reimbursing — Governmental Entity employer billed $655.20 for the quarter of the most recently mailed statement, with counted charges of $640.00: financing basis $655.20.
- A Reimbursing — Nonprofit Organization employer not yet billed for that quarter: financing basis nothing.
